messages:
lin: hey support — our org (org_0xabc123) shows $0 and NaN for token cost in the dashboard for several subaccounts since ~2026-03-15 23:00 UTC. Not seeing charges in billing page either. Any help?

maria: sorry for the trouble, lin. can you paste the org id and a screenshot? are these subaccounts under a parent org? any recent changes to keys or plan?

lin: org id: org_0xabc123. yes we have subaccounts (team-a, team-b). attached screenshot: https://files.redwood/test-screenshot.png. We're on Dedicated.

maria: thanks. pinging @alex for billing eng and @kai for metrics pipeline. i'll open a ticket. :eyes:

alex: looking. quick check of the ledger shows rows with cost = 0 and cost = NULL for events where event_type = 'inference_token' but org_id is NULL and parent_org_id is present. suspect ETL change that started emitting org_id=null for subaccounts.

kai: metrics pipeline shows a transform landed in staging yesterday midnight that changed join key from org_id -> canonical_id. if canonical_id not found, we left org_id null. backfill status: job 'billing_canonical_map' failed on 2026-03-15 23:05 with timeout.

maria: can you confirm whether this is a display bug (dashboard) or actual missing cost records?

alex: costs are missing from aggregated view because dashboards join ledger.events -> orgs using org_id and ignore parent_org_id/backfill. ledger still contains token events but with null org_id so they drop out. not a calculation bug exactly but ETL data loss.

kai: quick repro SQL (local) — run below to see NULL org rows:
```sql
select count(*) from ledger.events where event_type='inference_token' and org_id is null and created_at > '2026-03-15';
```

lin: yeah that matches: we ran that and saw ~12k rows. what's mitigation? we need costs for billing export tomorrow.

alex: two options: 1) revert the staging transform in prod (fast) so future writes include org_id; 2) run backfill to populate org_id from canonical map for the missing window. revert + backfill recommended. will coordinate rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @alex: deploy id dpl-439 at 1849121200

alex: revert pushed to prod, monitoring ETL. starting backfill job now (job id backfill-184912). will post progress. ETA ~2h for 12k rows.

kai: backfill job completed: updated 12,438 rows. dashboard query now returns proper totals. please confirm on your end.

lin: confirmed — dashboard shows costs again for team-a/team-b. thanks all :pray: We'll monitor next 24h and report if anything else.

maria: closing the ticket after 24h if stable. filing postmortem to add alert on canonical_map backfill failures and dashboard null-checks.
